metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:calibration: Frozen tolerances and operators on <=32 identified training-prefix targets. Targets may have influenced fitting. No validation labels or additional predictor.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:references: Readout reference enumerates nonzero indices. Residual reference separately composes the supplied block primitives in eval mode. Causality compares identical prefixes.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:mutants: Denominator includes every applicable, independently witnessed known-non-equivalent operator/input instance, including survivors. Unresolved instances remain visible outside it. Known non-equivalence refers to the specified index or block-boundary observable; endpoint effects and detections are reported separately. Sampled equality never proves equivalence.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampling: Frozen-score ranks use score descending then item ID ascending. For N negatives and K preceding the target, rank=1+Hypergeom(N,K,m). Two hundred private permutations provide descriptive Monte Carlo means and standard errors, without a rejection policy.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:endpoint_pairs: Equal-user, in-sample positive-minus-first-fixed-negative margins in eval mode. These do not reproduce the position-weighted training loss or its negative distribution.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:unavailable: Missing identity, unsupported graph/objective or absent observations are null, not evidence of healthy behavior. No human intent or validation-performance inference.
